Class DefaultAnnotationMemberElement

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.inject.ast.utils.DefaultAnnotationMemberElement
All Implemented Interfaces:
AnnotatedElement, AnnotationMetadata, AnnotationMetadataDelegate, AnnotationMetadataProvider, AnnotationSource, Described, Named, MutableAnnotationMetadataDelegate<Element>, AnnotationMemberElement, Element, MemberElement, TypedElement
@Internal public final class DefaultAnnotationMemberElement extends Object implements AnnotationMemberElement
An AnnotationMemberElement over the element a compiler answers an annotation member as: a method element under javac and the Groovy compiler, a property element under KSP.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • getDefaultValue

      public Optional<Object> getDefaultValue()
      Description copied from interface: AnnotationMemberElement
      The default value the member declares, in the form the annotation metadata records a value of the member: a boxed primitive, a String, the name of an enum constant, an AnnotationClassValue for a class, an AnnotationValue for a nested annotation, or an array of those.

      The value is the one VisitorContext.getAnnotationDefaultValues(String) answers for the member, so an empty string default is reported. Under KSP the defaults of an annotation class are only visible on a use of the annotation, so a member of a Kotlin annotation that no element of the compilation is annotated with reports no default. A Python declared annotation is visited before its generated annotation type exists, and until then its defaults keep the shape the Python processor reports and the metadata records: a class by its name as a String, a list as a List.

      Specified by:
      getDefaultValue in interface AnnotationMemberElement
      Returns:
      The default value, or empty when the member declares none or it cannot be resolved

    • removeAnnotation

      public Element removeAnnotation(String annotationType)
      Description copied from interface: MutableAnnotationMetadataDelegate
      Removes an annotation of the given type from the element.

      If the annotation features any stereotypes these will also be removed unless there are other annotations that reference the stereotype to be removed.

      In the case of repeatable annotations this method will remove all repeated annotations, effectively clearing out all declared repeated annotations of the given type.

      Specified by:
      removeAnnotation in interface Element
      Specified by:
      removeAnnotation in interface MutableAnnotationMetadataDelegate<Element>
      Parameters:
